name: Crossroads Executive & Charter
tagline: Executive and charter flying from the Crossroads of America.

divisions.name: Executive
divisions.summary: Light and mid-size aircraft from Indianapolis Executive, from the Piper M600 turboprop to the Citation X, plus the Longitude and Gulfstreams at KIND for coast-to-coast and transatlantic trips. Teterboro, Aspen, Boca Raton, Vail, Toronto, Geneva and Le Bourget.

divisions.name: Executive Charter
divisions.summary: VIP-configured Airbus jets for delegations, tours and private groups: the 48-seat A220, the 100-seat A340-600 and the 150-seat A380, flying from Indianapolis International to Las Vegas, Los Angeles, Houston, Geneva and Paris.

divisions.name: Group & Sports Charter
divisions.summary: Teams, bands and incentive groups in the E175, E190 and 757 from Indianapolis International to game-day cities, Orlando, Tampa, Cancun and beyond.

divisions.name: Cargo Charter
divisions.summary: A300-600F, MD-11F and 777F freighters on ad-hoc runs to Miami, Newark, Oakland, Ontario, Anchorage, Stansted, Leipzig and Liege.
